g.text: Also present: fixed SiLU tables, activation quantization, adders, dividers and greedy argmax; not all use DSP blocks.

g.text: Floating-point multipliers may use multiple DSP blocks; integer adders can also map into DSP blocks.

g.text: Clocks in this image: 100 MHz inference / 125 MHz memory / 250 MHz host. 28 layers; hidden size 2,048; 16 Q heads / 8 K/V heads; head width 128.

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f46

g.text: HBM = high-bandwidth memory. BF16 / FP32 = floating-point formats. Private = no ordinary host operand/address interface, not physical memory secrecy.

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a

g.text: Scope: selected paths in the released baseline, not every wire or a physical layout. 32,768-token design capacity is not full-context hardware qualification.

text.style: font-size: 14.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52687a

g.text: The AWS host and configuration plane are outside the inference-only claim. Mapped resources and a schematic do not prove physical-tamper resistance.
